## Engineering Task Shape Analysis — `jeroenterheerdt/HAsmartirrigation` @ `9ad5a7d`

This is a Home Assistant custom component (HACS) for weather-based smart irrigation. The codebase at the cutoff represents a fork (`@altmenorg`) that has accumulated significant development on top of the upstream `jeroenterheerdt` project. Below are the evidenced task shapes, each cited to specific artifacts.

---

### 1. Feature

The dominant shape at this cutoff. Multiple independently-bounded capabilities were added, each introducing new constants, store fields, logic, and—frequently—a dedicated mixin file.

**Direct valve control (optional executor)**
The integration can now open/close linked HA entities (switches, valves) itself, rather than requiring user automations. Introduced the full `ValveRunnerMixin` in [`valve_runner.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/valve_runner.py), constants `CONF_DIRECT_VALVE_CONTROL_ENABLED`, `CONF_ZONE_SEQUENCING`, `CONF_ACTIVE_VALVE_RUNS`, `RUN_*` keys in [`const.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/const.py?L59-79), and `direct_valve_control_enabled` / `active_valve_runs` fields in [`store.py`'s `Config`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/store.py?L259-265).

**Observed watering (closed-loop bucket crediting)**
[`observed_watering.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/observed_watering.py) — `ObservedWateringMixin` tracks linked valve state changes and credits the zone bucket from real run time or a linked flow sensor volume. Adds `ZONE_LINKED_ENTITY`, `ZONE_FLOW_SENSOR`, `ZONE_LAST_IRRIGATION`, `ZONE_WATER_USED` in [`const.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/const.py?L304-311) and corresponding `ZoneEntry` fields in [`store.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/store.py?L174-180). Credited as adapted from JustChr's fork.

**Configurable irrigation start triggers**
[`triggers.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/triggers.py) — `TriggersMixin` supports sunrise, sunset, and solar-azimuth triggers. The `TRIGGER_*` constants and `active_start_trigger` / `irrigation_start_triggers` config fields replace the hardcoded "sunrise minus total duration" behavior. Tested in [`test_next_irrigation_trigger.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/tests/test_next_irrigation_trigger.py).

**Weather-based skip on precipitation**
`_check_precipitation_forecast` in [`skip_conditions.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/skip_conditions.py?L41-60), with `CONF_SKIP_IRRIGATION_ON_PRECIPITATION` and `CONF_PRECIPITATION_THRESHOLD_MM` constants.

**Days-between-irrigation throttle**
`CONF_DAYS_BETWEEN_IRRIGATION` / `CONF_DAYS_SINCE_LAST_IRRIGATION` in [`const.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/const.py?L81-85) and `skip_conditions.py`.

**Enhanced scheduling (recurring schedules and seasonal adjustments)**
[`scheduler.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/scheduler.py) provides `RecurringScheduleManager` (daily/weekly/monthly/interval types) and `SeasonalAdjustmentManager`. Full service API: `SERVICE_CREATE_RECURRING_SCHEDULE`, `SERVICE_UPDATE_*`, `SERVICE_DELETE_*`, `SERVICE_CREATE_SEASONAL_ADJUSTMENT`, etc. in [`const.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/const.py?L463-477).

**Irrigation Unlimited integration bridge**
[`irrigation_unlimited.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/irrigation_unlimited.py) — `IrrigationUnlimitedIntegration` discovers IU entities and provides sync/share-zone-data services.

**Watering calendar generation**
[`watering_calendar.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/watering_calendar.py) — `WateringCalendarMixin.async_generate_watering_calendar` builds a synthetic 12-month planning calendar per zone using latitude-based climate data.

**Solar radiation fallback for OWM/PirateWeather**
[`SolarRadiationFallback.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/weathermodules/SolarRadiationFallback.py) — `SolarRadiationFallbackClient` transparently fills missing solar radiation and ET0 fields from Open-Meteo for providers that lack them.

**Manual coordinates**
`CONF_MANUAL_COORDINATES_ENABLED`, `CONF_MANUAL_LATITUDE/LONGITUDE/ELEVATION` in [`const.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/const.py?L158-163), corresponding `Config` attrs in [`store.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/store.py?L250-253).

---

### 2. Localized Bug Fix

**Duplicate duration entity on upgrade/downgrade cycle**
`_migrate_duration_unique_ids` in [`__init__.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/__init__.py?L78-141) detects and removes stale duplicate `sensor.smart_irrigation_<slug>` unique IDs left over from a version cycle, preventing setup failure on collision.

**Diagnostics mutate live hass.data**
Comment in [`diagnostics.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/diagnostics.py?L20-24) explicitly calls out issue #758: downloading diagnostics previously broke running tabs by redacting the API key on the live dict in place. Fixed by building a separate output dict.

**Stale API key on reconfigure**
[`__init__.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/__init__.py?L185-200) — comment references issue #683: options (set by Reconfigure flow) now always override entry data, not only when `use_weather_service` changed, so updating only the API key takes effect and does not return HTTP 401.

**`TypeError` on startup from unrecognized config keys**
`MigratableStore._async_migrate_func` in [`store.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/store.py?L339-380) strips unknown keys from the persisted config via `attr.fields_dict(Config)` before constructing `Config(...)`, preventing `TypeError` from stale or future keys on disk.

---

### 3. Refactor

**`__init__.py` decomposition into mixins**
Multiple docstrings explicitly state "Extracted from `__init__.py`":
- [`calculation.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/calculation.py?L1-8) — `CalculationMixin`
- [`triggers.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/triggers.py?L1-9) — `TriggersMixin`
- [`skip_conditions.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/skip_conditions.py?L1-8) — `SkipConditionsMixin`
- [`watering_calendar.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/watering_calendar.py?L1-7) — `WateringCalendarMixin`

All four docstrings state "bodies are unchanged and still use `self` to reach coordinator state" — a behavior-preserving extraction into a mixin pattern. The main coordinator in `__init__.py` then inherits all mixins.

**`_populate_from_data` factoring in store**
[`store.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/store.py?L402-410) extracts a shared `_populate_from_data` method used by both `async_load` (from disk) and `async_import` (from user backup), replacing earlier duplication. The docstring explicitly notes "atomic restore."

---

### 4. Test Generation

A large test suite was clearly written alongside (or immediately after) the new features, with strong evidence they were generated in bulk rather than written incrementally:

- Root-level one-off scripts (`test_basic_functionality.py`, `test_comprehensive.py`, `test_comprehensive_triggers.py`, `test_datetime_fix_proof.py`, `test_enhanced_scheduling.py`, etc.) — exploratory/proof-of-concept scripts at the root, outside the `tests/` directory, many with `_proof` suffixes suggesting they were produced to validate a fix rather than as regression tests.
- `tests/test_helpers_coverage.py` — file name and content explicitly frame itself as a coverage-improvement exercise (`"Test Smart Irrigation helper functions to improve coverage"`), testing exception instantiation and string formatting rather than logic.
- `tests/test_store_operations.py` — tests basic CRUD operations (initialize, load, get config) at a granularity that mirrors method enumeration more than user-scenario coverage.
- `tests/test_valve_runner.py` and `tests/test_observed_watering.py` — better-quality targeted tests with realistic mocks, co-produced with `ValveRunnerMixin` and `ObservedWateringMixin`.
- Several test files disabled with `.disabled` suffix ([`test_continous_updates.py.disabled`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/tests/test_continous_updates.py.disabled), `test_zone_calculation.py.disabled`, etc.), indicating generated tests that could not be made to pass and were parked.

---

### 5. Dependency Migration

**OWM config key rename**
[`store.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/store.py?L284-298) — `_async_migrate_func` at `old_version == 3` renames `use_owm` → `use_weather_service` and sets `weather_service = "Open Weather Map"`. This is a data-layer migration tracking the upstream rename of the OWM-specific flag to a generic multi-provider flag.

**Open-Meteo promoted as default**
[`const.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/const.py?L198-201) — `CONF_DEFAULT_WEATHER_SERVICE = CONF_WEATHER_SERVICE_OM` with explicit comment "free, keyless, and it supplies solar radiation + FAO-56 ET0 out of the box." The requirements in [`manifest.json`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/manifest.json) dropped `pyeto` from declared dependencies (only `aiofiles` remains), suggesting the pyeto calculation module is now loaded dynamically rather than declared statically.

---

### 6. Documentation / Configuration

**`CLAUDE.md` — AI-session handoff document**
[`CLAUDE.md`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/CLAUDE.md) is a working-session context file for AI-assisted development, containing branch workflow, build conventions, deployment notes, and pointers to gitignored operational files (`HANDOFF.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`). This is not traditional project documentation; it is operational scaffolding for AI-assisted sessions.

**`Makefile`**
[`Makefile`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/Makefile) — introduces `setup`, `test`, `lint`, `format`, `check`, and `clean` targets, standardizing the local dev workflow and aligning it with CI (ruff + black). No logic changes.

**`pyproject.toml`**
[`pyproject.toml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/pyproject.toml) — configures ruff lint rule sets (E, F, B, I, UP, SIM) and explicit ignores. Configuration-only file.

**`const.py` inline comments**
Multiple constants in [`const.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/const.py) carry explanatory comments (e.g., `START_TRIGGER_DEFAULT` sentinel explanation at L43-46, `ZONE_ET_DEFICIENCY` note referencing issue #576 at L288-291, `CONF_ACTIVE_VALVE_RUNS` / `RUN_*` keys at L73-79). These are in-code documentation additions.

---

### 7. Architectural Scaffolding

**Mixin-based coordinator decomposition**
The central pattern of the codebase is that `SmartIrrigationCoordinator` (in `__init__.py`) inherits from `CalculationMixin`, `TriggersMixin`, `SkipConditionsMixin`, `WateringCalendarMixin`, `ObservedWateringMixin`, `ValveRunnerMixin`, `ServiceHandlersMixin`, and `IrrigationUnlimitedIntegration` (or a mixin thereof). The coordinator itself is declared in [`__init__.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/__init__.py?L41-61). This multi-inheritance mixin scaffold is the structural decision that enables future capabilities to be added as new files without modifying the coordinator core — evidenced by the consistent pattern across all new mixin files.

**`MigratableStore` subclass**
[`store.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/store.py?L268-382) — `MigratableStore(Store)` encapsulates version-to-version config migration behind a stable interface. The current STORAGE_VERSION is 5. This is a structural addition that makes future version bumps self-contained.

**`performance.py` decorator scaffold**
[`performance.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/performance.py) — a `@performance_timer` decorator factory handling both sync and async functions. The file exists as infrastructure; whether it is actually applied to hot paths at this cutoff is ambiguous (no call sites verified in this pass).

---

### 8. Cleanup

**Commented-out legacy code in `triggers.py`**
[`triggers.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/triggers.py?L39-46) retains a multi-line block of commented-out `sun_state` parsing (dead code from the original `register_start_event` implementation). Present but not removed.

**`ZONE_THROUGHPUT` duplicate constant**
[`const.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/const.py?L286-294) declares `ZONE_THROUGHPUT = "throughput"` twice (lines 286 and 294). This is an unresolved merge artifact.

**`CONF_IMPERIAL` duplicate constant**
[`const.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/const.py?L222-321) declares `CONF_IMPERIAL = "imperial"` at both L222 and L320 (within the metric/imperial unit block and again below). Same duplicate pattern.

---

### Ambiguity Notes

- **`blueprints/` and `examples/`** directories are present but not read in this pass. They likely contain YAML automation blueprints (documentation/configuration shape), but this is unconfirmed.
- **`irrigation_unlimited.py`** — its classification as "feature" vs. "architectural scaffolding" is ambiguous. It is a discrete capability (bridge to another integration) but also establishes a pattern for future third-party bridges. Classified as **feature** because it delivers a user-visible capability.
- **Disabled test files** — it is ambiguous whether `.disabled` files represent failed test generation or deliberately deferred work. The naming pattern (`_edge_cases`, `_continous_updates`) suggests they were generated and then found to be too tightly coupled to a live HA instance to run in CI.

---

### Taxonomy Refinement Proposal

The existing eight categories cover all observed shapes. One sub-distinction is worth noting but does not require a new top-level category:

> **Test generation** should be split into two sub-types when precision matters: **coverage-driven test generation** (producing tests to raise a metric, evidenced by `test_helpers_coverage.py` and the root `test_*.py` scripts) vs. **feature-co-developed tests** (written to validate a specific new capability, evidenced by `test_valve_runner.py`, `test_observed_watering.py`, `test_next_irrigation_trigger.py`). The two sub-types have different quality signals and different relationships to the code they test.

### 2. Localized Bug Fix

**Duplicate duration entity on upgrade/downgrade cycle**
`_migrate_duration_unique_ids` in [`__init__.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/__init__.py?L78-141) detects and removes stale duplicate `sensor.smart_irrigation_<slug>` unique IDs left over from a version cycle, preventing setup failure on collision.

**Diagnostics mutate live hass.data**
Comment in [`diagnostics.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/diagnostics.py?L20-24) explicitly calls out issue #758: downloading diagnostics previously broke running tabs by redacting the API key on the live dict in place. Fixed by building a separate output dict.

**Stale API key on reconfigure**
[`__init__.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/__init__.py?L185-200) — comment references issue #683: options (set by Reconfigure flow) now always override entry data, not only when `use_weather_service` changed, so updating only the API key takes effect and does not return HTTP 401.

**`TypeError` on startup from unrecognized config keys**
`MigratableStore._async_migrate_func` in [`store.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/store.py?L339-380) strips unknown keys from the persisted config via `attr.fields_dict(Config)` before constructing `Config(...)`, preventing `TypeError` from stale or future keys on disk.

### 3. Refactor

**`__init__.py` decomposition into mixins**
Multiple docstrings explicitly state "Extracted from `__init__.py`":
- [`calculation.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/calculation.py?L1-8) — `CalculationMixin`
- [`triggers.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/triggers.py?L1-9) — `TriggersMixin`
- [`skip_conditions.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/skip_conditions.py?L1-8) — `SkipConditionsMixin`
- [`watering_calendar.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/watering_calendar.py?L1-7) — `WateringCalendarMixin`

All four docstrings state "bodies are unchanged and still use `self` to reach coordinator state" — a behavior-preserving extraction into a mixin pattern. The main coordinator in `__init__.py` then inherits all mixins.

**`_populate_from_data` factoring in store**
[`store.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/store.py?L402-410) extracts a shared `_populate_from_data` method used by both `async_load` (from disk) and `async_import` (from user backup), replacing earlier duplication. The docstring explicitly notes "atomic restore."

### 4. Test Generation

A large test suite was clearly written alongside (or immediately after) the new features, with strong evidence they were generated in bulk rather than written incrementally:

- Root-level one-off scripts (`test_basic_functionality.py`, `test_comprehensive.py`, `test_comprehensive_triggers.py`, `test_datetime_fix_proof.py`, `test_enhanced_scheduling.py`, etc.) — exploratory/proof-of-concept scripts at the root, outside the `tests/` directory, many with `_proof` suffixes suggesting they were produced to validate a fix rather than as regression tests.
- `tests/test_helpers_coverage.py` — file name and content explicitly frame itself as a coverage-improvement exercise (`"Test Smart Irrigation helper functions to improve coverage"`), testing exception instantiation and string formatting rather than logic.
- `tests/test_store_operations.py` — tests basic CRUD operations (initialize, load, get config) at a granularity that mirrors method enumeration more than user-scenario coverage.
- `tests/test_valve_runner.py` and `tests/test_observed_watering.py` — better-quality targeted tests with realistic mocks, co-produced with `ValveRunnerMixin` and `ObservedWateringMixin`.
- Several test files disabled with `.disabled` suffix ([`test_continous_updates.py.disabled`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/tests/test_continous_updates.py.disabled), `test_zone_calculation.py.disabled`, etc.), indicating generated tests that could not be made to pass and were parked.

### 5. Dependency Migration

**OWM config key rename**
[`store.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/store.py?L284-298) — `_async_migrate_func` at `old_version == 3` renames `use_owm` → `use_weather_service` and sets `weather_service = "Open Weather Map"`. This is a data-layer migration tracking the upstream rename of the OWM-specific flag to a generic multi-provider flag.

**Open-Meteo promoted as default**

The requirements in [`manifest.json`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/manifest.json) dropped `pyeto` from declared dependencies (only `aiofiles` remains), suggesting the pyeto calculation module is now loaded dynamically rather than declared statically.

[`pyproject.toml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/pyproject.toml) — configures ruff lint rule sets (E, F, B, I, UP, SIM) and explicit ignores. Configuration-only file.

Multiple constants in [`const.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/const.py) carry explanatory comments (e.g., `START_TRIGGER_DEFAULT` sentinel explanation at L43-46, `ZONE_ET_DEFICIENCY` note referencing issue #576 at L288-291, `CONF_ACTIVE_VALVE_RUNS` / `RUN_*` keys at L73-79). These are in-code documentation additions.

### 7. Architectural Scaffolding

**Mixin-based coordinator decomposition**
The central pattern of the codebase is that `SmartIrrigationCoordinator` (in `__init__.py`) inherits from `CalculationMixin`, `TriggersMixin`, `SkipConditionsMixin`, `WateringCalendarMixin`, `ObservedWateringMixin`, `ValveRunnerMixin`, `ServiceHandlersMixin`, and `IrrigationUnlimitedIntegration` (or a mixin thereof). The coordinator itself is declared in [`__init__.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/__init__.py?L41-61). This multi-inheritance mixin scaffold is the structural decision that enables future capabilities to be added as new files without modifying the coordinator core — evidenced by the consistent pattern across all new mixin files.

**`MigratableStore` subclass**
[`store.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/store.py?L268-382) — `MigratableStore(Store)` encapsulates version-to-version config migration behind a stable interface. The current STORAGE_VERSION is 5. This is a structural addition that makes future version bumps self-contained.

**`performance.py` decorator scaffold**
[`performance.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/performance.py) — a `@performance_timer` decorator factory handling both sync and async functions. The file exists as infrastructure; whether it is actually applied to hot paths at this cutoff is ambiguous (no call sites verified in this pass).

Present but not removed.

[`const.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/const.py?L286-294) declares `ZONE_THROUGHPUT = "throughput"` twice (lines 286 and 294). This is an unresolved merge artifact.

**`CONF_IMPERIAL` duplicate constant**
[`const.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jeroenterheerdt-hasmartirrigation@9ad5a7d90ac2c42288536a6264cdc8adbea39b6a/-/blob/custom_components/smart_irrigation/const.py?L222-321) declares `CONF_IMPERIAL = "imperial"` at both L222 and L320 (within the metric/imperial unit block and again below). Same duplicate pattern.

---

### Ambiguity Notes

- **`blueprints/` and `examples/`** directories are present but not read in this pass. They likely contain YAML automation blueprints (documentation/configuration shape), but this is unconfirmed.
- **`irrigation_unlimited.py`** — its classification as "feature" vs. "architectural scaffolding" is ambiguous. It is a discrete capability (bridge to another integration) but also establishes a pattern for future third-party bridges. Classified as **feature** because it delivers a user-visible capability.
- **Disabled test files** — it is ambiguous whether `.disabled` files represent failed test generation or deliberately deferred work. The naming pattern (`_edge_cases`, `_continous_updates`) suggests they were generated and then found to be too tightly coupled to a live HA instance to run in CI.

---

### Taxonomy Refinement Proposal

The existing eight categories cover all observed shapes. One sub-distinction is worth noting but does not require a new top-level category:

> **Test generation** should be split into two sub-types when precision matters: **coverage-driven test generation** (producing tests to raise a metric, evidenced by `test_helpers_coverage.py` and the root `test_*.py` scripts) vs. **feature-co-developed tests** (written to validate a specific new capability, evidenced by `test_valve_runner.py`, `test_observed_watering.py`, `test_next_irrigation_trigger.py`). The two sub-types have different quality signals and different relationships to the code they test.
